headline: Leafan grass helper
title: Leafan | Three Jobs Grass Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for a flexible Grass worker in Palworld one point zero? Leafan works Planting level three, Handiwork level three and Gathering level three, plus Transporting level two. That is four jobs in one small Pal. Will you put Leafan to work at your base? Comment below!
description: Leafan in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass Pal with Planting, Handiwork and Gathering at level three and Transporting at level two.
joke: Leafan is not distracted by romance, only chores.
